trigger.note: No single round-level trigger pid. The base game is ST140 NormalCollectionSpin (paid; collect metronome CollectCount/AccCredits/CreditsSymbols is cosmetic state, the credited win is fully payline-attributed). The CreditsSymbol hold-and-respin block (ST125 -> settle ST130) is opened by a TriggerNineRespin event on the triggering paid ST140 (ReMarks='TriggerNineRespin', win=0) and/or via the Wheel (ST2 ReMarks carries 'TriggerNineRespin'); ST125 respins HOLD reels (LockReels grows) at cost=0 sharing the trigger's SpinTimes, win-INDEPENDENT (all ST125 win 0), settling ONCE on ST130 (FinalNormalMinigame, win>0, no payid). ST2 Wheel is the collect settlement (no payid, no BetAmount). CurJackpotStoreWin is present on every ST140/ST125/ST130 round but =0 on 100% of the sample (fleet-wide test-interface-zeroed progressive — M275/M279/M278 precedent). ST130 + ST2 have NO natural payid -> the config-only m245_creditsymbol_settlement SynthesizePayIdRule (spin_types=[130, 2], label_format=spin_type) attributes them.
